basis: The OPEN cycle's inventory reading for does-money-move-votes.md Finding 3, pinned because it is the only cell in that paper derived from a still-accruing source. Scope: source='FEC', office='H', state='WA', support_oppose IN ('S','O'), election_cycle=2026, read through v_independent_expenditures (the countable slice -- notices and memoed subtotals excluded, so these are periodic Schedule E rows, not 24/48-hour notices). WHAT THIS PIN IS: a dated reading, and the paper prints the date beside the row for exactly that reason. It is NOT a claim that the cycle is closed -- it is open, and the row will keep growing. The paper excludes it from the panel total for that reason, so no estimate in the paper depends on it. WHAT IT DOES NOT PROVE: that the live view still matches. It cannot -- FEC state is not reconstructible retroactively. The verifier reports live drift as a NOTICE rather than a failure, because a stale-by-design historical reading is not a defect and a gate that goes red every Monday is one people switch off. Re-pin deliberately (and re-print the date) if the paper is ever re-derived; do not silently refresh the cells.
